keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Domagoj Vida (AEK Athens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! AEK Athens 0, Universitatea Craiova 1. Stefan Baiaram (Universitatea Craiova) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal.
First Half ends, AEK Athens 0, Universitatea Craiova 1.
Second Half begins AEK Athens 0, Universitatea Craiova 1.

Goal! AEK Athens 0, Universitatea Craiova 2. Alexandru Cicâldau (Universitatea Craiova) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Assad Al Hamlawi following a fast break.
Substitution, AEK Athens. Niclas Eliasson replaces Roberto Pereyra.
Substitution, AEK Athens. Dereck Kutesa replaces Petros Mantalos.
Goal! AEK Athens 1, Universitatea Craiova 2. Domagoj Vida (AEK Athens) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Razvan Marin with a cross following a corner.
